meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 产品经理与项目管理专家在应对复杂项目时，使用此技能可动态组建包含“执行、指挥、评审”的专属AI团队。实时查看多智能体辩论与决策全过程，共享统一上下文记忆，一键完成从会议决策到系统构建的全流程高效协同！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建AI团队协同处理复杂项目，实时查看多智能体决策过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要多智能体协助管理复杂项目、决策与执行。
copy.tagline_en: Build an AI team to handle complex projects, watch multi-agent decisions live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent assistance in managing complex, decision-heavy projects.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按任务动态组建执行、指挥、评审三层角色的多智能体团队,所有智能体共享统一上下文记忆,并把讨论、辩论与决策过程实时展示出来。
howto.when: 当一项任务需要多个智能体协同完成,或你想为某个特定场景固定一组智能体角色时触发。适合多专业领域协作、多角度分析与决策等场景,简单任务不适用。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构
say.note: 主持人引导,各智能体发言辩论后给出决策记录

say.text: 请用OPC团队构建AI短视频领域的系统
say.note: 按战略分析、产品架构、自动化实现三步走

say.text: 开启实时沟通模式,让我看到智能体的讨论过程
say.note: 逐条显示发言、分歧与最终共识

howto.what_en: After install, Claude dynamically assembles a multi-agent team with execution, command, and review roles, shares one context memory across all agents, and shows their discussion, debate, and decision process live.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task needs several agents working together, or when you want a set agent combo for a specific scenario. Built for cross-domain work and multi-angle decisions; not for simple tasks.

say_en.text: Use the technical decision team to evaluate microservice architecture.
say_en.note: A host leads debate, then a decision record is produced.

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system in the AI short-video field.
say_en.note: Three steps: strategy, product design, build.

say_en.text: Turn on live communication mode so I can watch the agents talk.
say_en.note: Shows each speech, disagreement, and final consensus.
